# Pesher Habakkuk Column 4 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QpHab (Cave 1), Col. 4 | **Condition:** Well preserved

---

**4:1** "[...and-he] gathers captives like-sand.

**4:2** And-he — at-kings he-scoffs,

**4:3** and-rulers are a-laughingstock to-him. He-laughs at-every

**4:4** fortress; he-heaps-up earth and-captures-it" (Hab 1:9b-10).

**4:5** Its pesher concerns the-rulers-of the-Kittim, who

**4:6** despise the-fortresses-of the-peoples

**4:7** and-with-derision laugh at-them;

**4:8** and-they surround-them with-a-great army to-capture-them.

**4:9** And-in-dread and-terror they-are-delivered into-their-hand,

**4:10** and-they-tear-them-down because-of the-iniquity-of those-who-dwell in-them.

**4:11** "At-that-point he-changes his-spirit and-passes-on

**4:12** and-makes his-might his-god" (Hab 1:11).

**4:13** Its pesher concerns the-rulers-of the-Kittim,

**4:14** who by-the-counsel-of the-guilty-house pass one-before

**4:15** another; their-rulers come one after-another

**4:16** to-destroy the-earth.

**4:17** "And-he makes his-might his-god" — its pesher [...]

---
*EMET notes: Column 4 covers Hab 1:10-12. The pesher format alternates between quotations of Habakkuk and their sectarian interpretations (pesharim). Hyphenated forms reflect Hebrew construct chains and bound morphemes. Technical sectarian terms preserved: Teacher of Righteousness (Moreh ha-Tsedeq), Wicked Priest (ha-Kohen ha-Rasha'), Man of the Lie (Ish ha-Kazav), Kittim (identified with Romans), Spouter of the Lie (Mattif ha-Kazav). Lacunae marked with [...] represent genuine manuscript damage.*
